answer: A farm faking 90 aliases needs 90 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The timber is the wall and the grove is the gate: Craft brewer licence works as the check: a licence the brewing body renews after brewed batches. A farm of 90 aliases must climb the wall 90 times, the horizon ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
